payload.description:
Context: A containerized worker process that imports/runs Plexus code attempted to initialize its own CloudWatch application logging and create/use the default Plexus log group. That may be expected for first-party Plexus services, but it is surprising for embedded or batch-worker usage where the host runtime already owns stdout/stderr logging and log-group infrastructure.

Goal: determine why Plexus logging initializes CloudWatch shipping in this worker context, whether an environment/configuration guard is missing, and what default behavior should be for non-hosted or embedded Plexus runtimes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Identify the Plexus logging initialization path that triggers CloudWatch log-group creation.
- Document the configuration contract for enabling/disabling Plexus-managed CloudWatch shipping in worker or embedded runtimes.
- Recommend whether Plexus should default to stdout-only logging unless explicit CloudWatch logging configuration is present.
- Add tests or documentation in a follow-up implementation task before changing behavior.

Confidentiality note: keep all follow-up notes free of client names, account identifiers, ARNs, IP addresses, and runtime-specific incident details.
payload.title: Audit implicit Plexus CloudWatch log-group creation in worker runtimes
